claims.claim: On verified IGS20 2024-01-26 PHRI00NGA (3-ref extrapolation, zero rover leakage), atmospheric experimental VRS (vrs_idw2_unb3m) measurably improves static FLOAT horizontal RMSE (+8.23%, 95% CI [+0.047, +0.121] m) and kinematic 3D FLOAT RMSE (+14.14%) over the physical anchor.

Inside a dense 8-reference Nigerian convex hull (2011-03-20 OSGF), offline atmospheric VRS (vrs_ipp_idw2_unb3m) reduces kinematic FLOAT horizontal RMSE by +56.65%, static horizontal RMSE by +57.06%, and truth-independent centered scatter by -57.2% relative to the nearest physical anchor.
NLGCP experimental VRS currently achieves genuine centimetre-level RTK integer ambiguity resolution (FIX).
Geometry-only VRS without differential tropospheric modelling underperforms a physical reference anchor in RTKLIB v2.4.2-p13 due to loss of automatic baseline hydrostatic cancellation in zdres().
Full-day 2024 PHRI kinematic horizontal RMSE improvement (+5.70%) is statistically conclusive under 3-station extrapolation.

Atmospheric spatial interpolation improves ionospheric prediction inside multi-station convex hulls (+26.1% to +30.0% in 2011 9-station LOOCV), whereas sparse perimeter extrapolation remains ZERO-dominated.

UNB3m climatology predicts Nigerian zenith hydrostatic delay within 1.85 mm RMSE vs independent PRIDE PPP-AR 3.2.8 ZTD on 2024 DOY 026, while wet delay exhibits a 12.6 cm coastal-to-Harmattan spatial gradient.
NLGCP reproduces its Phase 3 single-base RTK control baseline (EKAK->PHRI 105.553 km) numerically to four decimals (0.9677 / 0.5838 / 1.1301 m) using pinned RTKLIB v2.4.2-p13.
NLGCP synthetic RTCM 1005/1074/1084 encoders and loopback NTRIP v2/v1 distribution (NLGCP_TEST) operate byte-exact and decode cleanly with unmodified RTKLIB v2.4.2-p13.
NLGCP RTCM 1005/1074 streams are independently verified across multiple non-RTKLIB MSM4 decoders and commercial GNSS rover receivers.
NLGCP supports causal real-time streaming atmospheric VRS generation.
NLGCP ingests authorized live Nigerian CORS / NTRIP streams in production.
NLGCP backend NTRIP caster is hardened and approved for public or controlled-network operational deployment.
NLGCP is approved for operational GNSS correction service delivery (OPERATIONAL_APPROVED).
